content: Install-time asset packs are served as split APKs and accessed only through AssetManager (InputStream); no filesystem path. Fast-follow/on-demand give absolute paths via AssetPackManager.getPackLocation().assetsPath(), require com.google.android.play:asset-delivery 2.3.0; REQUIRES_USER_CONFIRMATION when sideloaded. Play for On-device AI (beta) offers AI packs with device targeting (e.g. RAM).
